subject: Compile with -Wundef (#2025)
reason: The change only adds the -Wundef/-Werror=undef compiler flag and rewrites '#if MACRO' conditionals to '#if defined(MACRO) && MACRO'. Since an undefined macro already evaluates to 0 in a preprocessor #if, every rewritten conditional (config.h, crcspeed.c, debug.c, rdma.c, rio.c, sentinel.c, setproctitle.c, tls.c) selects exactly the same code as before, and lzfP.h's new '#define USE_REP_MOVSB 0' default matches the prior implicit value. This is a build/warning-hygiene change with no runtime behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
